stem: Which statement BEST describes what happens as water changes from one state to another?

options.label: A
options.text: As water is cooled, it freezes and changes from a solid to a liquid.

options.label: B
options.text: As water is cooled, it condenses and changes from a gas to a liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: As water is heated, it evaporates and changes from a liquid to a solid.

options.label: D
options.text: As water is heated, it melts and changes from a gas to a solid.
